title: Electronic Hardware EMC Engineer
desc:
Job Description
Assessment of electronic devices according to EMC aspects and development of solutions
Carrying out analyses with regards to circuit diagrams, circuit board design and mechanical design
Active support in the development of technical solutions
Analysis of customer requirements according to EMC
Development of test plans
Plan and conduct EMC tests at external labs and analyze the test results
Profile Description
Minimum Bachelors degree in Electrical/Electronics Engineering or, preferably, Masters and/or PhD qualifications.
Minimum 2 years of experience in Electronic Hardware Design or validation of electronic components including electromagnetic compatibility (EMC).
Fluent speaking and excellent writing skills in English.
German language skill would be a plus.
Willingness to travel abroad
No military service obligations (military service completed)
Good understanding of, and experience in, at least three of the following topics:
Automotive Electronics
Low/High Voltage Analog Circuit Design
Switch Mode Power Supplies
Embedded Systems Hardware Design
Spice Simulation Tools (in particular, LT Spice)
Schematic & PCB Layout Design
Automotive-specific Components & Design Rules
Electromagnetic compatibility analysis and tests
